detect_univariate_trend: create an MKDetector with time series data and call detector with window_size to find monotonic trends
detect_multivariate_trend: create an MKDetector with multivariate data set to true and run detector to find trends across metrics
get_MK_statistics: call get_MK_statistics after detector to retrieve the dataframe of Mann-Kendall test results for all time points
filter_trend_direction: call get_MK_results with direction up or down to filter detected trends by their direction
plot_detected_changepoints: call plot with detected time points to visualize the time series with changepoint vertical lines
